svg.title: 1978 and 1982 Israeli Invasions of Lebanon (Operation Litani & Operation Peace for Galilee)
svg.desc: GCSE History cartographic map of Lebanon and Northern Israel showing the 1978 Litani UNIFIL buffer, Sharon's stated 40 km limit in June 1982, IDF coastal and Bekaa Valley advances, the Siege of West Beirut, PLO evacuation by sea to Tunis, Sabra and Shatila, and the 1985–2000 Israeli Security Zone.
